def workflow():
    # Create a new Box folder
    box_folder = Box\_Folder__3\_0\_0\_\_create\_Folder("New Contacts")

    # Create a new Salesforce contact
    salesforce\_contact = Salesforce\_Contact\_\_5\_0\_0\_\_create\_Contact(
        first\_name="John", last\_name="Doe", email="johndoe@example.com"
    )

    # Create a new file in the Box folder with the Salesforce contact's information
    file\_content = f"First Name: {salesforce\_contact['first\_name']}\nLast Name: {salesforce\_contact['last\_name']}\nEmail: {salesforce\_contact['email']}"
    box\_file = Box\_File__3\_0\_0\_\_create\_File(
        box\_folder["id"], "contact\_info.txt", file\_content.encode()
    )

    # Send an email using Gmail with a link to the new Box file
    gmail\_mail = Gmail\_mail__2\_0\_0\_\_create\_mail(
        to="johndoe@example.com",
        subject="Your New Contact",
        body=f"Here is the link to your new contact file: {box\_file['permalink']}",
    )

    # Send the email
    Gmail\_mail__2\_0\_0\_\_send\_mail(gmail\_mail)
